steps.what: Review the wireless configuration before it is applied

tasks.design: The specialist installs and configures wireless networking equipment. The install and the choice of configuration stay at full effort. {OPS_SYSTEM} applies only the wireless configuration the specialist has accepted. A blank setting stays blank and stops the apply. This apply is not a firewall change and not a fault close.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist installed the equipment and applied the configuration by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted wireless configuration can be applied. Choosing it stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Installing the equipment and choosing the configuration stay with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a configuration the equipment does not support.
tasks.altitude: The wireless configuration is applied only after the specialist accepts that version.

reach.task: Hear which wireless install was refused

evidence.claim: An accepted wireless configuration can be applied later. Installing the equipment and choosing the configuration stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with wireless equipment and ends when the accepted configuration is applied, or the specialist stops.
A wireless proposal has equipment identifier and setting name with value, entered by the specialist. A blank setting is left blank and is not invented.
The apply uses the configuration accepted in the review. It does not choose the settings.
unknowns: Which wireless settings a specialist may apply without a second person.
research_questions: How often did a blank setting stop the apply?

already_counted.description: Configuring the wireless equipment is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a setting before the configuration is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: settings are often blank, so the specialist still configures the equipment. High: settings are complete, the specialist reviews them, and only the accepted configuration is applied. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Keep the existing logs of network activity running
Maintain a check of those network activity logs

tasks.design: The specialist maintains logs of network activity. The log in {DATA_PLATFORM} already runs, and that runtime is not the specialist's time. The specialist still checks the log at full effort. A blank event stays blank. The check does not extend what the log records.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist checked a log that already runs.
tasks.enabler_now: The log already runs. Checking it is still the specialist's work.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that a log entry needs action stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not treat a blank event as an incident.
tasks.altitude: The log's runtime is not new labour. The check stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear when a log check found a blank event
reach.learn: Which days the log was blank.

evidence.claim: An existing network activity log already runs. Checking it stays manual.
A log that can observe staff may need a works-council consultation before it is extended. The applicable rules are those in force for this organisation. The existing log's runtime is not new labour.

assumptions: The work starts when the log has run and ends when the specialist has checked it or stopped.
A log row has time, source, and event, written by the existing log. A blank event is left blank. The log's runtime is not the specialist's time.
The check does not extend the log. Upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which events the specialist must look at the same day.
research_questions: How often was the event blank, so the specialist could not treat the row as an incident?

already_counted.description: Checking the network activity logs is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the log already runs.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every log is still checked by the specialist. High: the same check remains, and the log's runtime is not counted. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document help desk requests and resolutions

steps.what: Enter help desk requests and the resolutions
Document those help desk requests and resolutions
Review the help desk record before filing
File the accepted help desk record

tasks.design: The specialist documents help desk requests and resolutions. {HELPDESK} copies only fields the specialist entered. It does not write the resolution and it does not close the request. A blank resolution stays blank and stops the record. Only the accepted record is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist typed the request and the resolution and filed them.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored request and resolution fields can be copied into a record. The specialist still enters them.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the resolution stays with the specialist. Filing does not close the request.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a record that fills a blank resolution.
tasks.altitude: The record is filed only after the specialist accepts that version. The request is not closed by the filing.

evidence.claim: Stored request and resolution fields can be copied into a record. The specialist enters and reviews them. Filing does not close the request.

assumptions: The work starts with a request and ends when the accepted record is filed, or the specialist stops. Filing does not close the request.
A field set has request identifier, requester, request text, and resolution text, entered by the specialist. A blank resolution is left blank and is not invented.
Filing uses the record accepted in the review.
unknowns: Which requests must have a resolution before the record can be filed.
research_questions: How often did a blank resolution stop the record?

already_counted.description: Entering the requests and resolutions is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a resolution before the record is accepted.

approvals.approved_version: help desk record the specialist accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: resolutions are often blank, so the specialist still writes the record. High: fields are complete, the specialist reviews, and only the accepted record is filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research products for networking or security needs

steps.what: Show stored attributes of hardware or software products
Research hardware products to meet technical networking needs
Research software products to meet technical security needs

tasks.design: The specialist researches hardware or software products to meet technical networking or security needs. {DATA_PLATFORM} shows stored attributes only. A blank attribute stays blank. Showing them does not shorten the research or the choice, which stay at full effort. No product is ordered here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist compared products and chose.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored attributes can be shown. The research and the choice stay manual.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what meets the need stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not choose a product whose attribute is blank.
tasks.altitude: The research and the choice stay at full effort. The screen only shows stored attributes.

reach.task: State the networking or security need

evidence.claim: Stored product attributes can be shown. Researching and choosing stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a technical need and ends when the specialist has chosen or stopped. Nothing is ordered.
An attribute row has category, attribute name, and attribute value, entered by the specialist from the sheet. A blank value is left blank. No brand is required for the row.
Showing the attributes does not shorten the choice.
unknowns: Which needs must be met before a product can be proposed.
research_questions: How often was an attribute blank, so the specialist went back to the sheet?

already_counted.description: Researching hardware products is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct an attribute value the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: attributes are often blank, so the choice is unchanged. High: attributes are shown, and the specialist still researches and chooses. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
